settings.heading: The Story of Ruhe Noor
settings.text_1: Born from an obsession with the purest botanical extracts and centuries-old distillation traditions, Ruhe Noor was established to bring back the lost art of true Haute Parfumerie.
settings.text_2: Each formula is developed without compromise, using rare French Jasmine, wild Damascena Roses, and aged Arabian Ouds aged in our dark cellars for over six months before being hand-poured into heavy crystal flacons.

settings.question: What makes Ruhe Noor fragrances unique?
settings.answer: We formulate exclusively in Extrait de Parfum concentration (30%+ perfume oils) using cold-distilled botanicals and vintage aged resins. Each batch matures for six months in our cellars before bottling.

settings.question: How long do the fragrances last on skin and fabric?
settings.answer: Because of our high concentration of natural resinous base notes (such as Amber, Oud, and Bourbon Vanilla), our extraits typically project for 12 to 16+ hours on skin and remain discernable on garments for multiple days.

settings.question: Are Ruhe Noor fragrances unisex?
settings.answer: Yes. We believe olfactory elegance transcends conventional gender boundaries. Our compositions are balanced with harmonic top, heart, and base tiers that evolve uniquely on each individual's skin chemistry.

settings.question: Can I test the fragrances before purchasing a full flacon?
settings.answer: Absolutely. We offer our Atelier Discovery Wardrobe (5 x 10ml vials), and every full-size flacon order automatically includes two complimentary travel samples so you can test on your skin before opening the main presentation box.

settings.question: How should I store my luxury perfume flacon?
settings.answer: Keep your flacon in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, humidity, and drastic temperature changes. Storing it inside its original linen presentation box ensures the volatile natural top notes remain pristine.
